A learning route to a reliable handover

A project example, another perspective, a learning question and your own decision.

1 · Albrecht

The handbook explains the current workflow. When a procedure changes, the rule, example and responsibility are updated together.

2 · Emre

A newcomer compares current files with earlier instructions. He distinguishes a finding, a possible explanation and an open question.

3 · Two learning questions

Git stores traces of work, not automatically every reason or the currently applicable procedure. A difference between the guide and pipeline does not establish an intention or personal trait.

4 · Our action

Which one rule will we improve now? Who supports it, which version does it concern, and how will we test whether it helps the next person?

Short route · Anna

A one-person project can begin with brief instructions: the authoritative copy, checking/transferring and recovery.
